## Work

- [QIC digital hub](https://qic.digital/): senior backend engineer since 2025; helped launch a new Go-based motor-insurance backend and QIC Travel, and built observability foundations across 25 services
- [Noveo](https://noveogroup.com/): senior java developer, 2021–2025; built and operated five Java/Kotlin microservices and acted as tech lead for five engineers
- [7bits](https://7bits.it/): full-stack software engineer, 2017–2021; built Java/Kotlin/Spring and React/TypeScript products across the full development cycle

## Projects

- [voomy](https://dev.voomy.tv/product): a pre-launch bilingual creator platform for video, subscriptions, paid access, discovery, community, and moderation
